explanation: Expand the left side: 4x + 12k - 6k + 6x + 36 = 10x + 6k + 36. Expand the right side: 2x + 132 - x - 27 = x + 105. So 10x + 6k + 36 = x + 105, which gives 9x + 6k = 69. The left-hand point has x > 0 when the line lies above the point where the parabola crosses the y-axis: at x = 0, y = -2(9) + 50 = 32, so c must satisfy 32 < c < 50. subskill: Linear function from sums of consecutive values
prompt: A linear function f has these properties: adding its nine outputs f(1), f(2), ..., f(9) gives -270, while adding just its three outputs f(7), f(8), and f(9) gives -45. Its graph crosses the axes at (r, 0) and (0, s). What is the value of r + s?
explanation: Because f is linear, its values at equally spaced inputs increase by the same amount each step, so a sum of values at consecutive integers equals the number of terms times the value at the middle input. The nine values f(1) through f(9) have middle input 5, so 9f(5) = -270 and f(5) = -30. The three values f(7), f(8), f(9) have middle input 8, so 3f(8) = -45 and f(8) = -15. The slope is (-15 - (-30))/(8 - 5) = 5, so f(x) = 5x + b with 25 + b = -30, giving b = -55. Then s = -55, and 5r - 55 = 0 gives r = 11. So r + s = 11 + (-55) = -44.
